acceptanceCriteria: Two worktrees run dogfood check concurrently without refusal, with a test.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: two lanes in one repo share the .context-corvint trace store, so the second lane's dogfood check refuses.

Expected: the store is isolated per worktree.

Acceptance: two worktrees run dogfood check concurrently without refusal, with a test.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: DCW-V0-044 dogfood tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Lanes in one repo share the .context-corvint trace store; second lane's dogfood check refuses
